messages:
kyle: NexaSupply called — batch of 16x A100s from WH2 flagged: 3 DOA, 2 failing burn-in, and one shipment held by NL customs for missing tariff doc. They propose depot recall or air-swap. Need decision on expedited replacements and whether we accept return-to-vendor. @maria @ryan
maria: Can you paste the RMA/ASN? also which serials are DOA vs failing burn-in?
nexasupply_rep: Hey team — ASN 4XNL-7721, AWB: 555-GBR-CH-910. Serial list attached (sent to ops inbox). Quick summary: DOA units: S/N A100-113, A100-116, A100-119. Burn-in failures: A100-122, A100-125. Customs hold is for S/N A100-129 (missing EU tariff code). We can either depot-recall whole pallet or ship 3 air-replacements FOB quickair within 48h (expedite fee).
ryan: If we air-replace, need to confirm compatibility with our swap policy and who covers return freight. Our Dedicated capacity SLA is impacted if we lose >8 GPUs. Right now cluster health shows degraded on WH2-rack-7.
sam: Cluster alert: 7 GPUs down, scheduling some pods to other region but cross-region egress costs spike. If we postpone replacements, we run longer with degraded perf. Estimated uplift cost for 48h failover ~ $12k.
maria: What's the expedite fee and can we offset with RMA credit? Also customs doc — can vendor push corrected CN22/HS code? (HS 8473.30) @nexasupply_rep
nexasupply_rep: Expedite air = $950/unit (incl insurance). We can reissue commercial invoice with HS 847330. For returns: vendor covers return freight for DOA only; burn-in failures are warranty RMA but vendor asks for depot test first (we'd pay inbound if not DOA).
kyle: Proposal: accept 3 air-replacements for DOA immediately, vendor to reissue docs for customs, we RMA burn-in units with depot test route (vendor covers return if confirmed DOA). Ask vendor to prepay export label for A100-129 to clear customs today. @vendor-bot please create RMA ticket
vendor-bot: RMA ticket created: RMA-2026-9876. Notes: pre-authorize air swap, escalate customs doc. SLA target: 48h.
ryan: Agree but want vendor to confirm replacement model/firmware match. We had one incident of mismatch causing perf regression. Ask for firmware build id + recommended driver.
nexasupply_rep: Confirmed: replacements are same A100 NL SKU, FW v7.2.1, driver 540.30. We will send checksums and image notes. Shipping ETA 48h once label cleared.
maria: I'll approve air swap if vendor pushes commercial invoice and prepaid label now. Kyle, please confirm with finance that expedite fee <$3k net (we'll invoice back).
kyle: Approved. I'll ping finance and update this thread. Sending PO amendment 8897-EXP now.
